findings: Reject for now. Fact: the design keeps Q07 at 60% despite concentration warning and L-112 single-signal failure, and reuses CVaR-family logic after L-013 hard fail. Inference: the 40/60 blend looks like parameter relabeling of prior defense failures, not true mechanism novelty. Speculation: perceived stability may be sample-period dependent and fragile in Korean risk-on regime shifts.
conditions: Reduce Q07 to <=35% and impose explicit concentration/correlation caps across D45/D47/D48 and Q07.
Define strict PIT data protocol: filing publication timestamps, restatement handling, and T+1 execution alignment for all inputs.
Replace fixed 40/60 with walk-forward expanding-window weight estimation and stability constraints across subperiods.
Require incremental performance over Q07-only and tail-only baselines after turnover/costs.
Pass pre-registered stress gates across distinct Korean regimes, not only aggregate full-period metrics.

kill_scenarios.scenario: A global rates shock hits KOSPI; D47/D48/D45 become highly collinear and act like market beta. The tail sleeve and Q07 crowd into similar defensive names and draw down together instead of diversifying.
kill_scenarios.expected_loss: MDD expands to roughly 50-57% and SR deteriorates by about 0.3-0.5.

kill_scenarios.scenario: Q07 is computed with revised financials or incorrect report-availability dates, creating hidden lookahead. Backtest quality appears strong, but live signals use stale/pre-restatement data, especially among late-reporting KOSDAQ firms.
kill_scenarios.expected_loss: Live IC turns negative for multiple quarters; SR drops 0.25-0.4 with additional 8-12%p drawdown.

kill_scenarios.scenario: A prolonged KOSDAQ-led risk-on recovery penalizes defensive tilts. Frequent VaR/CVaR re-ranking adds transition cost while missing high-beta rebounds, causing cumulative relative decay.
kill_scenarios.expected_loss: Annual alpha declines by 4-7%, IR falls by about 0.2-0.35, and relative MDD widens by 10-15%p.

weakest_assumption: If Q07 earnings stability can safely remain the 60% core despite known concentration and prior standalone failure, then concentration dominates portfolio behavior -> the tail sleeve becomes a correlated overlay rather than a true hedge -> terminal state is MDD breaching 45% (potentially 50%+) with SR collapsing toward zero or negative.
design_pit_assessment: Q1: Concerned; factor choice appears ex-post conditioned on known crisis behavior and prior failures. Q2: Possibly, but only with strict real-time publication-lag controls and expanding windows, which are not specified. Q3: Concerned; the 40/60 combination appears outcome-conditioned rather than mechanism-first. Q4: Concerned; ICIR>=0.20 and MDD<45% gates may be full-sample tuned unless pre-registered out of sample. Overall PIT risk is material and unresolved.
